title: EmbeddingGemma 2 model card
note: Google documents an Apache-2.0 open-weight embedding model with a 270M text-only configuration, 740M full configuration, and supported 128/256/512/768 dimensions. No Athena batch or device performance measured.

title: EmbeddingGemma 2 multimodal and precision guide
note: Google says FP16 activations are incompatible; use bfloat16 on a supported GPU or float32. Media loading and runtime memory still require verification. Do not assume same-model embeddings are compatible across mismatched dimensions or preprocessing.

title: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B model card
note: Apache-2.0 text comparison lane, 32K context and up to 1,024 dimensions per publisher. Keep model revisions, query instructions, pooling, normalization, and dimensions explicit.

title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B model card
note: Apache-2.0 multimodal candidate supporting text, images and videos according to its model card. Do not attribute standalone audio support; native performance is unmeasured.

title: BGE-M3 model card
note: MIT text comparison lane with dense, sparse and multi-vector retrieval, 8,192-token documented context. Evaluate each retrieval mode separately; no primary score from the Athena corpus yet.
